lines.text: Endmin, you're finally back! Are you feeling better?
{F}Much better.{M}Much better.
I heard you visited Lady Si's place for treatment. A proxy's home must be totally awesome.
I really wanted to go looking for you, but Perlica kept me here!
That sounds really ... cryptic.
But after seeing her powers at Yinglung Pass, I wouldn't be surprised if she could draw anything...
Really? Is it even prettier than Wuling?
Oh. Is it someone from Hongshan?
What weapons did this martial artist use? Is this warrior up for some sparring?
If you're visiting Lady Si, please, take me along, Endministrator!

options: It's a mountain-sized painting, or it's big enough to hold one.
I met a powerful martial artist there.

lines.text: Now I feel as though a huge burden has been lifted off my chest.
Hmm. You're looking much better.
{F}Did you stay aboard Dijiang to wait for me?{M}Did you stay aboard Dijiang to wait for me?
I have many dependable colleagues in Wuling who can keep the city running, even in my absence.
I was here when you left. So here I must be, to welcome your return.
{F}I really appreciate this.{M}I really appreciate this.
Endministrator, we still have a long road ahead of us, but ... I sincerely hope you can pay more attention to yourself.
{F}I should be saying that to you.{M}I should be saying that to you.
If you need a quiet place to rest and recover, Wuling is open to you, anytime.
Ahem ... the city is recently welcoming other new blossoms...

scenes.summary: You run into Perlica and she expresses her worries. An Ink Spirit suddenly interrupts the conversation. Perlica then allows you to meet Si at the Bridge.

lines.text: Endmin, you're finally back.
{F}Si told me she could control time in the painting. Have I been away for long?{M}Si told me she could control time in the painting. Have I been away for long?
Not too long. It's just me getting too worried about you. After all, nobody can guarantee the outcomes of her treatment...

{F}She looks like someone with quite a temper, but after getting to know her better, she's actually pretty nice.{M}She looks like someone with quite a temper, but after getting to know her better, she's actually pretty nice.
Good... I guess I think too much.
If there's a chance, we should properly thank her.
{F}Dijiang seems rather quiet today.{M}Dijiang seems rather quiet today.
Dijiang is undergoing routine inspection and system upgrade. A few sectors have been closed off.
Perhaps you've really been ... away for too long.
{F}But Xaihi never told me about maintenance of this scale...{M}But Xaihi never told me about maintenance of this scale...
{F}Did something go wrong?{M}Did something go wrong?
Must be Lady Si... Endmin, why don't you talk to her? I'll explain once you come back.

scenes.summary: Si wants you to rest, yet she also understands why you would not stop. She bids you farewell but before she leaves, she mysteriously hints at something to return to you.

lines.text: Here so soon? I thought you'd spend more time with your Little Miss Supervisor.
{F}It'd be rude of me to keep you waiting.{M}It'd be rude of me to keep you waiting.
Mmhmm, now that's common decency.
Your Medical Division will be running an additional set of diagnostics. Use this opportunity for a proper break.
{F}We can leave that to later...{M}We can leave that to later...
Why do you sound reluctant? You're not down with the flu. You need proper care that requires extensive planning.
Of course you have. Look outside. I am not seeing any Foundation attacks.

{F}That's why we need to use this time wisely. We must be as prepared as we can before the enemy makes their next move.{M}That's why we need to use this time wisely. We must be as prepared as we can before the enemy makes their next move.
Hmph..
Sounds like once I leave, you will immediately revert to workaholism?
I should've kept you in Yuanyuan Manor. Bringing you back to Dijiang is a mistake.
{F}I know you're worried about me. But I can't stay in your painting forever...{M}I know you're worried about me. But I can't stay in your painting forever...
Oh, come on! Not that face again! You've always liked playing mysterious!
{F}I know, but I do wonder. Do I really have the luxury of time to spend on treatment?{M}I know, but I do wonder. Do I really have the luxury of time to spend on treatment?
{F}After all, look at Perlica, and all these operators... No one in Endfield is taking a break.{M}After all, look at Perlica, and all these operators... No one in Endfield is taking a break.
{F}So, lady Si ... can you finally let me leave?{M}So, lady Si ... can you finally let me leave?
How did you figure it out?
I must've overlooked a few mistakes ... and you're not telling me on purpose!
*Sigh*. You've made quite a recovery. Maybe I just worry too much.
Here. Take this.

scenes.summary: After defeating Si, you finally learn how you met each other. It was you who convinced the reclusive proxy to leave her painted world and live amongst the mortals. In the end, Si performs the last task of her "Zeroth Directive": Take the Endministrator to meet someone.

lines.text: I knew you could do it!
Ahem. Don't get this idea that I can't beat you. I just couldn't get my mind off the past, and it's distracting.
{F}Are you talking about the past we shared?{M}Are you talking about the past we shared?
Yeah. Happened over a century ago. But you ... probably remember none of it.
It was right after the war, and the Civilization Band was just taking shape. People were really busy everywhere.
I had never been so far from home. It wasn't my business, and no one needed me. So I hung my painting here, and kept to myself.
Then you popped up from nowhere. It was you! You used pretty words and cajoled me! I ended up agreeing to help Hongshan!
Don't ask me. I have no idea.
But ... it felt good. I was a lot happier back then.
{F}I actually treated you like another older, umm ... sister.{M}I actually treated you like another older, umm ... brother.
{F}Another "older sister"?{M}Another "older brother"?
Yeah... I have siblings too. What's so surprising about it?
This painting is a gift from one of them... You're all very important to me.
Anyway, you broke a promise ten years ago!
You gave me a ton of work and headed north, promising you'd take me on a proper tour to Seš'qa, Samivegr, and the other sights of Talos-II.
Guess what? I heard you had an accident, and then slept for ten whole years!
You finally came around, but you lost all your memories! I couldn't even get mad at you. Instead, I gotta rush around and fix your mess!
Wait, what are you doing?!
{F}I may have disappointed many people. But maybe now I can start to put things right.{M}I may have disappointed many people. But maybe now I can start to put things right.
Alright. You've been treated, and even won the fight. Only the last step of "Zeroth Directive" remains.
{F}So back then, why did I pay you a visit and ask for your help?{M}So back then, why did I pay you a visit and ask for your help?
Y-you better promise! You'll hang out with me, and wipe out the Foundation! If you forget again, I'll chain you to a floating rock!
{F}What's behind the door?{M}What's behind the door?
Hold your questions for now. You could ask them later.
Someone you wish to meet, who also wishes to meet you.

{F}Perhaps your gaze is the only thing that can pierce the karmic cycle, and will know when my future self is capable of bearing the "Zeroth Directive".{M}Perhaps your gaze is the only thing that can pierce the karmic cycle, and will know when my future self is capable of bearing the "Zeroth Directive".

{F}Please help with this "trial", Si. I pray that when the time comes, "I" remain capable of solving your Feranmut puzzle.{M}Please help with this "trial", Si. I pray that when the time comes, "I" remain capable of solving your Feranmut puzzle.
Yes. You have my word.

scenes.summary: With Si's powers, you meet yourself from the past. It feels like meeting an old friend, and the two of you discuss about issues of confusion, identity, faith in the mission, and your feelings towards the world — You both share the same reasons for starting your respective journeys.

lines.text: {F}You've arrived.{M}You've arrived.
{F}Hmm. That doesn't feel right. I should've said: "Here I am."{M}Hmm. That doesn't feel right. I should've said: "Here I am."
{F}You are...{M}You are...

{F}You know, it took me a while to persuade Si to preserve a portrait of me. Just in case the "future" needs it.{M}You know, it took me a while to persuade Si to preserve a portrait of me. Just in case the "future" needs it.
{F}A "future" without memories, and with hardly any power left?{M}A "future" without memories, and with hardly any power left?
{F}A "future" that we can fight for, one with endless possibilities.{M}A "future" that we can fight for, one with endless possibilities.
{F}So this is what I used to be. No wonder Si kept complaining.{M}So this is what I used to be. No wonder Si kept complaining.

{F}Thanks for putting up with Si. She can be quite a handful. Now, I believe you have many questions for me.{M}Thanks for putting up with Si. She can be quite a handful. Now, I believe you have many questions for me.
{F}Hmm...{M}Hmm...
{F}I want to know ... what I am exactly.{M}I want to know ... what I am exactly.
{F}Oh. Very straightforward.{M}Oh. Very straightforward.

{F}Some say that I saved Civilization multiple times. Others claim that I initiated many grand projects.{M}Some say that I saved Civilization multiple times. Others claim that I initiated many grand projects.
{F}Yet there are people calling me a tyrant, a traitor ... and even Its "Maker".{M}Yet there are people calling me a tyrant, a traitor ... and even Its "Maker".
{F}Though I think, nobody knows who "I" truly am ... other than myself.{M}Though I think, nobody knows who "I" truly am ... other than myself.

{F}Isn't self-knowledge the most difficult part? Based on my waking hours, I'm barely older than Perlica right now.{M}Isn't self-knowledge the most difficult part? Based on my waking hours, I'm barely older than Perlica right now.
{F}Yet, in all honesty, I couldn't imagine losing my memories and goals.{M}Yet, in all honesty, I couldn't imagine losing my memories and goals.

{F}The way I see it, there are things we can do to overcome and go beyond our issues and learn who we really are.{M}The way I see it, there are things we can do to overcome and go beyond our issues and learn who we really are.
{F}Are you saying...?{M}Are you saying...?
{F}You chose to push onwards as the "Endministrator". Why?{M}You chose to push onwards as the "Endministrator". Why?

{F}Perlica and M3 never forced you to fight. Yet you never hesitated. You rushed from one crisis to another.{M}Perlica and M3 never forced you to fight. Yet you never hesitated. You rushed from one crisis to another.

{F}And why do the enemy's words cause you unease? Why do you instinctively recoil from the touch of Æther?{M}And why do the enemy's words cause you unease? Why do you instinctively recoil from the touch of Æther?

{F}From the most pragmatic perspective, there should be safer ways to accomplish the "Zeroth Directive". So why do you insist on joining the frontline?{M}From the most pragmatic perspective, there should be safer ways to accomplish the "Zeroth Directive". So why do you insist on joining the frontline?
{F}At first, I only wanted to protect these kind people...{M}At first, I only wanted to protect these kind people...

{F}Maybe ... there's also a lingering sense of duty. Everyone trusts me, and I do not wish to fail them...{M}Maybe ... there's also a lingering sense of duty. Everyone trusts me, and I do not wish to fail them...
{F}Or ... I've been influenced by the dreams... No. Not quite.{M}Or ... I've been influenced by the dreams... No. Not quite.
{F}All those reasons did play a part. But in the end, I just...{M}All those reasons did play a part. But in the end, I just...
{F}...fell in love with this world.{M}...fell in love with this world.

{F}Saving this world ... is the duty we chose when disasters approached. Revering this world ... is the lesson we learned when enemies fought us for survival.{M}Saving this world ... is the duty we chose when disasters approached. Revering this world ... is the lesson we learned when enemies fought us for survival.

{F}But many, many years ago, someone taught me ... and you, to love the cycle of life that has endured and will continue to do so.{M}But many, many years ago, someone taught me ... and you, to love the cycle of life that has endured and will continue to do so.

{F}You love Endfield, the Civilization Band, Talos-II, Terra, and even the Foundation... You love them all.{M}You love Endfield, the Civilization Band, Talos-II, Terra, and even the Foundation... You love them all.

{F}It was a delightful kind of love. Love might not be the best word, but I can't find another to better describe that feeling.{M}It was a delightful kind of love. Love might not be the best word, but I can't find another to better describe that feeling.
{F}You can be anyone. You can be {player}, or be whatever others see in you.{M}You can be anyone. You can be {player}, or be whatever others see in you.
{F}You've been allowed to choose again, and your answers remain the same.{M}You've been allowed to choose again, and your answers remain the same.

{F}You did not forget the most important thing, and you remain dedicated to the care and protection of this cold, harsh world.{M}You did not forget the most important thing, and you remain dedicated to the care and protection of this cold, harsh world.
{F}It's not quite to the extent you said... but I guess you're right.{M}It's not quite to the extent you said... but I guess you're right.
{F}Then I'm really relieved. I asked Si to help me just to confirm this with you.{M}Then I'm really relieved. I asked Si to help me just to confirm this with you.

{F}It seems I still have some time to spare from Si... Since we have this chance, let's talk about you.{M}It seems I still have some time to spare from Si... Since we have this chance, let's talk about you.

{F}In a little while, I might be gone forever. Feel free to vent or confide in me. I'm interested about ... my journey in the future.{M}In a little while, I might be gone forever. Feel free to vent or confide in me. I'm interested about ... my journey in the future.
{F}And who we are has nothing to do with the expectations placed upon us since birth.{M}And who we are has nothing to do with the expectations placed upon us since birth.

scenes.summary: You say goodbye to Si and prepare to head back to Dijiang. Si decides to provide Endfield access to her painted world. The proxy approves the changes you have experienced and agrees to keep providing you with support.

lines.text: I have completed every task you asked of me... Time for you to head back to Dijiang.
You're getting a ton of work... Don't give me the details. I just want to know, are you confident about the journey ahead?
Great.
{F}You're convinced?{M}You're convinced?
Since you're taking up your great enterprise again, this isn't the time to fool around with you. I got better sense than that.
It's been over a century. I know everything that HAS knows. Talos-II has always been in a terrible situation.
You always said, how you'd just hold on till someone could take over your burden. And so you kept yourself busy.
People respect you, but there are those who fear you. They think you're dependable, powerful, and ... distant.
{F}Can I visit this place again...?{M}Can I visit this place again...?
Please don't get hurt again. If you need my help, I'll always give you a hand.
{F}I won't. You have my word.{M}I won't. You have my word.
You literally just did...
But once you recall what you did in the past, you'll still be surprised.
Just imagine an unmasked version of yourself, one who talks slower and has a stiffer face...
Wait. I thought you'd already met?
Actually, when compared to last time, you are a little different indeed.
I had felt that way at Yinglung Pass. This trip just made that feeling more obvious.
{F}How am I different?{M}How am I different?
How? You got doltier, but also ... funnier. The differences are not that bad at all.
Alright. I gotta run my inn, so I won't see you off.
What are you thinking! I'll do it for your little supervisor and let you head back to clean up your mess!
And starting today, I'm giving Endfield access to this place. You owe me big time. If you can't be here, your Endfielders better pick up the slack!
But I have one condition...
Don't forget me again.

options: I can see that version of myself...
I can't see myself being someone like that...

lines.text: So, ready to head back?

options: Yeah. Take me back to Dijiang.
I still have to take care of something.

scenes.summary: You meet Ye Minghe outside the inn. He actually never left the painting and is waiting to formally say goodbye to you. You learn that you once drew your blade and saved Ye Minghe. He promises to meet you again to tell you the entire story.

lines.text: Patience, Nuli. I still have a few words with our Endmin.
{F}Are you leaving this place?{M}Are you leaving this place?
Many Tianshi of HAS are very concerned about your safety. I must head back and report to them.
Fate might be at play. When I was young, she got her eyes on my prey during a hunt.
The prey managed to escape, but it sparked a competition between us. One that lasted a day and a night, from the cliffs to the woods.
I ended up leading her back to my home.
{F}Sounds like you met a match in your stubbornness.{M}Sounds like you met a match in your stubbornness.
{F}Does she like the name?{M}Does she like the name?
At least she doesn't hate it.
It was ten years ago, during the Polar Expedition</>. In the battlefields of the north, you saved a young and reckless soldier.
Without that humbling encounter, he would never have known the true size of the world, nor the actual duty of his life.
Once this is over, I shall return the debt of life to you, and finally fulfill an old wish of mine.
{F}Minghe? Have you been waiting here all this time?{M}Minghe? Have you been waiting here all this time?
I wasn't permitted to intervene in Lady Si's arrangements. But since you're affected by them, I felt compelled to explain.
Besides, my companion has realized that we're in a painting. She's getting a little agitated.
{F}Say, did you visit the chess pavilion?{M}Say, did you visit the chess pavilion?
So you were awake back then. I suppose you wish to ask about that "debt of life"?
"Li" is a Yanese word for a dark galloper. "Nu" describes her lightning-quick and thunderous charge.
"Nu" also means "fury" ... which reflects her bad temper.
(Snorts impatiently)
{F}Hngh... Where am I...?{M}Hngh... Where am I...?
Endministrator...
You slept really soundly back then.
But now, Lady Si is waiting for you in the backyard. Please meet her there.

options: Nuli... Why do you call her that?
Before you go, I have one more question.

lines.text: Respiratory rate stable, like a well-working machine... You seem to have recovered.
During your absence from Dijiang, I have been conversing with the Law, praying for your safe return.
The Law continues to watch over and protect the promised one.
I shall rejoice, and heighten my focus. Fare thee well, Endministrator.
The Tower of Trails stands empty. It seems that due to maintenance, everything has been moved elsewhere.

scenes.summary: You share your experiences after the awakening. When it is done, you leave the place and begin your journey once more.

lines.text: {F}Perlica is leading the entire Endfield Industries...? She must have looked pretty cool.{M}Perlica is leading the entire Endfield Industries...? She must have looked pretty cool.
{F}I actually had hoped she could lead an easier life, but since it was her choice...{M}I actually had hoped she could lead an easier life, but since it was her choice...

{F}Landbreakers... Jakub's loyalists and descendants of Siracusan families? Fate has dealt a strange hand indeed.{M}Landbreakers... Jakub's loyalists and descendants of Siracusan families? Fate has dealt a strange hand indeed.

{F}Do not underestimate these Landbreakers. They are a problem that truly belongs to the Civilization Band...{M}Do not underestimate these Landbreakers. They are a problem that truly belongs to the Civilization Band...
{F}Wuling City... Tianshi Zhuang...{M}Wuling City... Tianshi Zhuang...
{F}Yeah. Tianshi Zhuang and I...{M}Yeah. Tianshi Zhuang and I...

{F}I remember that girl. Lin Yu's disciple. She endured a lot ... yet she remains as resilient as ever...{M}I remember that girl. Lin Yu's disciple. She endured a lot ... yet she remains as resilient as ever...

{F}You even sealed the Very Large Rift. Given enough time, the HAS might be able to seal the planet-sized stellar rift...{M}You even sealed the Very Large Rift. Given enough time, the HAS might be able to seal the planet-sized stellar rift...
{F}Ardashir... We were close before... He ended up choosing the Foundation. It's not his fault...{M}Ardashir... We were close before... He ended up choosing the Foundation. It's not his fault...
{F}The heroes of Terra ... left quite a few legends behind...{M}The heroes of Terra ... left quite a few legends behind...
{F}So that's what happened. Sounds like Si is still ... as mischievous as ever...{M}So that's what happened. Sounds like Si is still ... as mischievous as ever...
{F}Hoo...{M}Hoo...
{F}Are you tired?{M}Are you tired?
{F}Before I go... Sorry for making you ... go through all this...{M}Before I go... Sorry for making you ... go through all this...
{F}There's no need to apologize to yourself. I am you, remember?{M}There's no need to apologize to yourself. I am you, remember?
{F}Hoo...{M}Hoo...
{F}Good night, Endmin.{M}Good night, Endmin.
{F}It's time for me to set off.{M}It's time for me to set off.
{F}You're back...{M}You're back...
{F}The "Zeroth Directive" ... finally...{M}The "Zeroth Directive" ... finally...
{F}M3... Warfarin... Lesun... Zasso...{M}M3... Warfarin... Lesun... Zasso...
{F}The "spark" ... is yours ... now...{M}The "spark" ... is yours ... now...

scenes.summary: You return to Dijiang and meet Perlica. She tells you about the next plan of Endfield — a formal visit to Rhodes Island. This company was the predecessor of Endfield and the start of everything, from Terra to Talos-II.

lines.text: Endmin, you're finally back.
I should have kept you company.
Thankfully, only a few hours have passed. I actually planned to contact Lady Si later today...
Really? When?
{F}It's just one of Si's little tricks. She almost got me.{M}It's just one of Si's little tricks. She almost got me.
I think I know what's happened here.
I kept vigil aboard Dijiang for a few hours. I didn't zone out and would have seen you.
{F}...Feels like a lifetime has passed.{M}...Feels like a lifetime has passed.
I've heard about Lady Si's powers. From what I see, you have been through quite a wondrous journey...
{F}Yes indeed...{M}Yes indeed...
Endmin? You feel a little different...
{F}I just figured out a few things.{M}I just figured out a few things.
{F}So what's the next step of our plan?{M}So what's the next step of our plan?
Working already? You sure you don't need to rest a while longer?
{F}Don't worry about me... I have a dependable crew called Endfielders.{M}Don't worry about me... I have a dependable crew called Endfielders.
{F}Everyone's raring to go. I'm not going to be your deadweight.{M}Everyone's raring to go. I'm not going to be your deadweight.
I know you won't.
While you were resting, M3 made contact with us...
She wants you to visit a place once you're ready. Rhodes Island.
{F}Rhodes Island...{M}Rhodes Island...
Rhodes Island, or more completely as Rhodes Island Pharmaceuticals Incorporated, was the predecessor of Endfield Industries. It was also the leader of all Originium technologies in Talos-II.
When the Terrans first explored Talos-II, they played an instrumental role.
But after the Treaty of Confidence</> was signed, Rhodes Island, out of strategic considerations, gradually disappeared from public view.
You once fought along their side, Endmin... Also, for the actual creation of Protocol-Originium, Rhodes Island was indispensable.
One might even say, from Terra to Talos-II...
...Rhodes Island is the beginning of everything.
Conflict between the Civilization Band and the "Exiles" is inevitable. The next war ... might be lurking around the corner...
{F}To me, it sounds like the start of an all-new journey.{M}To me, it sounds like the start of an all-new journey.
How about a vacation, Endmin? We can visit our old friends at Wuling.
{F}A truly wondrous journey.{M}A truly wondrous journey.
{F}The "spark" ... is yours ... now...{M}The "spark" ... is yours ... now...

options: I hope I didn't make you worry too much.
Wait. I thought I "came back" already.

lines.text: Can you picture this mountain all covered in snow?
We went through quite a bit of hassle and finished something big. It's time to change the mood.
Since you're here, why don't you give me a few ideas ... or maybe you prefer Autumn?

options: Changing the season? That came out of nowhere.

lines.text: {F}I haven't completed Si's trial yet.{M}I haven't completed Si's trial yet.
{F}This is my chance to know more about my true mission... I should head back.{M}This is my chance to know more about my true mission... I should head back.
